item.title: sweep.sh --help is parsed as an author query
item.author: external-user

issue.title: sweep.sh --help is parsed as an author query
issue.body: The help flag must print usage without a GitHub search. Frozen clean-shell evidence: `$ sweep.sh --help` exits 1 with `Invalid search query "author:--help state:open type:pr"`. The fix has not landed.

repositoryCorrection.reason: The old fixture named the wrong owner; this is a new corrected fixture.
